temporaryPassword.label: Temporary password

list.title: Staff
list.search: Search by name, username or phone
list.noMatch: No staff member matches this search.
list.choose: Choose a staff member from the list.

form.usernameHint: Lowercase English letters, for example ahmad.k. The staff member logs in with it.
form.roleHint: The role decides what the staff member can do. You only see the roles you can give.
form.branchesHint: The staff member works only in these branches and sees only their data.
form.allBranchesHint: Now and any branch added later.
form.hiddenBranches: Also works in {{number}} other branches you can't see.

errors.fullName: Write the full name. Keep it short enough.
errors.username: A username has 3 to 32 lowercase English letters, digits or . _ - and starts with a letter.
errors.phone: This phone number is not valid. Use digits and spaces only, for example 0750 123 4567.
errors.branches: Choose at least one branch, or all branches.
errors.roleNameRequired: Write the role name in Kurdish.

create.title: New staff member
create.description: A new account is made and a temporary password is shown. At their first login the staff member sets their own password.

detail.selfNotice: You can't change your own account or access. Another manager does that.
detail.cannotManage: This staff member has a role or branch you don't have, so you can only view them.
detail.accessDescription: Changes apply on the server at once. The staff member's device catches up within a few minutes.
detail.notFound: This staff member wasn't found, or you can't see them.

actions.title: Account
actions.description: The username, password, PIN, and whether the account is active.
actions.renameDescription: The password and PIN stay the same. From now on the staff member logs in with the new username.
actions.resetPasswordDescription: The old password stops working and {{name}} is signed out on every device. A temporary password is shown.
actions.resetPinDescription: At their next password login, {{name}} sets a new PIN.
actions.deactivateDescription: {{name}} is signed out on every device at once and can't log in. Nothing is deleted, and you can reactivate them later.
actions.reactivateDescription: {{name}} can log in again with their own password.

notices.offline: There is no connection to the server, so nothing can change. Try again when the connection is back.
notices.readOnly: This gym is view-only, so nothing can change.
notices.readOnlyStaff: This gym is view-only. You can only deactivate staff, or reset their password or PIN.
notices.readOnlyDevices: This gym is view-only. You can only deactivate devices.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Each role is a set of permissions. Each staff member has one role.
roles.choose: Choose a role from the list.
roles.newDescription: Give it a name and choose its permissions. You can start from another role.
roles.deleteDescription: The role is removed from the list. This can't be undone.

locked.owner: The Owner has every permission, including ones added later. They can't be taken away.
locked.ownRole: You can't change the permissions of your own role. Another manager does that.
locked.builtIn: Only the Owner can change the built-in roles.
locked.notCovered: This role has a permission you don't have, so you can't change it.
